reference.notes:
All 238 tests in the package pass, including both `generate-id-confirmed.*` files and the two hidden suites. Nothing fails.

Most of the spec was already in the working tree: the three modules under `src/schema/`, the barrel in `src/schema.ts`, and `ID_PREFIXES`/`IdPrefix` in `mapping.ts`. I compared the moved tables with the original `schema.ts` from the commit, and the only differences are the import lines and one comment about the import cycle. No table changed.

Two things were still missing, and I fixed both:
- **`src/mapping.ts:57`** — `generateId` took a prefix but ignored it and always returned `todo_<uuid>`. It now returns `` `${prefix}_${crypto.randomUUID()}` ``, so passing nothing or `undefined` still gives `todo_`, and other values go in unchecked as the spec says.
- **`src/index.ts:18-19`** — the package root now also re-exports `ID_PREFIXES` and the `IdPrefix` type from `./mapping.js`.
